title: Microwave Power-to-Frequency Transduction in a Magnetically Initiated Rydberg Dissipative Time Crystal
summary: Microwave power-to-frequency transduction is demonstrated using the emergent oscillation frequency of a magnetically initiated Rydberg dissipative time crystal (DTC). In a room-temperature 87Rb vapor, a ~14 G magnetic field establishes a self-sustained DTC near 21 kHz, while a near-resonant 8.325 GHz field coupling the 63D3/2 to 64P3/2 manifold continuously shifts the autonomous oscillation frequency.
